readiness: empty daemon list before and after connected stops
lateControl: budget from actual worker disconnect/permanent-close timestamps; actual null claim anchor; owned SIGKILL; at most three timing-only retries; exit 0/completion fail immediately; actual drain before permanent close/no Fatal required
earlyControl: 60s poll after actual null claim; permanent close before any drain marker
heldControl: actual null claim; wait for drain marker before repeated signals
timingMissHandling: Fatal before permanent close retries from calibration when no later close timestamp exists
